fair_value_reason: P/E: NTM EPS at Sep 2027 of ~$3.86 (0.25 x FY27 $3.58 + 0.75 x FY28 $3.96) x 22.5x = $86.9. FCF: FY27 ~$2.2B / ~785M average shares = $2.80 at a 3.2% yield = $87.5. EV cross-check: $4.65B NTM EBITDA x 16.5x less ~$8.7B forward net debt, over ~785M shares = $86.6, using agent_2's corrected net debt. Blend ~$87, versus the forecasters' mean of $88.1. The difference is the multiple: 22.5x rather than 23x, because the ORLY/AZO premium is at its historical high.
supervisor_summary: The revised forecasts moved down slightly (fair values $86-89.6, mean $88.1; P(>=85) 0.547). They adopted verified round-1 facts, but some of the agreement is anchoring on shared inputs, not independent confirmation. My checks settled the remaining factual disputes in the agents' favour: net debt is ~$7.5B (the August notes refinanced CP), the interest drag is ~$0.05, and AZO's tariff refunds do not transfer to ORLY. The one thing I change is the multiple. ORLY trades at 1.42x AZO's P/E, above its 2015-2025 range (median 1.27x), so I centre on 22.5x and a fair value of ~$87 with a ~$64 thesis break. The change is small and my confidence low, so the mean should stand. Q3 (~Oct 21-28) and GPC (Oct 20) are the near-term tests.
key_drivers: Multiple: ORLY trades at ~1.42x AZO's trailing P/E, above its 2015-2025 year-end range of 1.03-1.36x (median 1.27x). I centre on 22.5x NTM, not 23x; each 0.5x is ~$1.9 a share.
Comps after same-SKU inflation fades from 5.5% (Q2) to 1-2% in H2: pro growth (~+10%) has to offset low-single-digit DIY transaction declines. Q3 (~Oct 21-28) is the first test.

EPS compounding of ~10% a year: ~3.5% store growth plus ~4% net buybacks, with leverage near the 2.5x target. Debt-funded buybacks are about EPS-neutral at ~24x, so the interest drag versus consensus is only ~$0.05.
Peer read-through: AZO domestic +1.6% with a stronger last 8 weeks, but its gross margin was flattered by 145bp of tariff refunds. ORLY has no comparable one-off (GM flat at 51.4%).
Small tails: a levered NAPA deal (~5%) and fuel prices (AAA ~$4.4-4.5) hurting DIY.
